## ExecutableTrustStatus.approvedHashes property

Hashes recorded as approved for this executable in the trust manifest, in approval order (empty when the executable has never been approved). When [ExecutableTrustStatus.hashMismatch](./vaultkeeper.executabletruststatus.hashmismatch.md) is `true`<!-- -->, these are the prior approved values that [ExecutableTrustStatus.hash](./vaultkeeper.executabletruststatus.hash.md) no longer matches; the last element is the most recently approved hash.

**Signature:**

```typescript
approvedHashes: readonly string[];
```
